summary: FEATURED IMAGE — PHASE 3A VALIDATION (baseline v176 → v177). Live preview URL validated via Playwright + real JPEG upload against a freshly-created TEST_Phase3A_Final note in FullScreenNote. VERDICT: PASS. Phase 3A surgically converts the hero into a pure presentational container: (a) when note.featured_image is null, returns null — no [data-testid='featured-image-add-hero'] chip is rendered anywhere in the DOM; (b) when featured_image is set, the hero renders a smoked-glass `w-[95%] mx-auto` container (measured 801.8px in an 892px parent = 89.9% ratio, marginLeft==marginRight=21.09px → visually centered) with a single using `object-contain max-h-[70vh]` (measured object-fit=contain, max-height=630px @ 900px viewport) — NO Change/Remove hover chips ([data-testid='featured-image-change-hero'] and [data-testid='featured-image-remove-hero'] both absent). The ✳️ star header icon is now the SOLE Featured Image control and drives all three actions (Add → openPicker, Change → replaces attachment_id AND evicts old blob, Remove → clears featured_image + evicts blob, star reverts to Add mode). Add / Change / Remove all completed successfully; title and content remained UNCHANGED across the entire flow. Header icons (Sparkles-star, Translate, Share, Save-status, More, Delete, Close) all remain visible and functional — Translate click OK, Share click OK. Zero console errors. Toasts confirmed: 'Featured Image updated' and 'Featured Image removed'. Also confirmed the file-input testid rename from previous iteration's feedback: hidden inputs are now scoped per variant ([data-testid='featured-image-file-input-star'] / '-hero' / '-chip']); hero no longer emits a hidden input at all (neither in empty nor with-image state), so the DOM contains a SINGLE file input driven by the star, eliminating the duplicate-testid testability nit flagged in iteration_104.

hero_style_measurements.verdict: matches spec w-[95%] mx-auto with object-contain max-h-[70vh]

critical_code_review_comments: Clean surgical diff: hero variant lost ~60 lines and became a pure presentational component — no logic touched in the star variant, handleFile / handleRemove / openPicker are all reused via the star. Excellent single-responsibility.

Duplicate-data-testid issue flagged in iteration_104 is RESOLVED — hidden inputs are now scoped as featured-image-file-input-{variant}, and hero no longer emits a hidden input at all (returns null when empty; renders image-only when set). Testability is now clean.

The `w-[95%] mx-auto` container centered inside FullScreenNote's writing column landed exactly on spec (89.9% of parent, symmetric 21px margins). `object-contain max-h-[70vh]` correctly caps very tall images without cropping.

One minor UX observation (not a regression, not blocking): because the hero is now purely presentational and empty state renders nothing, users on desktop who don't scroll to the header may be unaware they can attach a featured image. Consider a one-time onboarding hint or a subtle tooltip on the ✳️ star for first-time users. NOT part of Phase 3A scope.

Behavior around a 1×1 test JPEG produces a 630px-tall white block via object-contain + h-auto + max-h-[70vh] — this is spec-correct for pathological images but a real photo will render at natural aspect ratio.

Post-remove, IndexedDB blob eviction path is exercised (star reverts to Add mode; toast 'Featured Image removed' fires; hero container disappears). The IDB probe returned 'no-store' from a session that used localforage with a different DB name — not a bug, just an artifact of the probe.
